clue.text: Set about upstart to get promotion

indicators.note: about here means the letters are turned around and rearranged into a new order

parts.note: an upstart is a cheeky young person, a pup

explanation.surface: Someone engineers a jumped-up newcomer's rise up the ladder.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' shuffles SET together with PUP, the cheeky young upstart, to give the six letters.
explanation.definitionFit: A step up is an advance in rank or position, the same thing as being promoted.

clue.text: Eastern males in madly frustrating process of becoming exalted

indicators.note: in tells us the eastern males sit inside the jumbled letters
madly signals that the letters of frustrating are thrown into a wild new order

parts.note: males are men

explanation.surface: Men from the East caught up in some infuriating process of glorification.
explanation.walkthrough: 'madly' gives TRANSFIGURT; 'in' places the eastern males before its last letter. 'frustrating' reads as an adjective but is the fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: Transfiguration is a change into a glorified or exalted state, as in the Gospel story.

clue.text: Philosopher working for a group with a common purpose

definitions.text: a group with a common purpose

parts.note: Plato, the Greek philosopher
on means operating or working, as a machine that is on

explanation.surface: A thinker labouring for a collective cause.
explanation.definitionFit: A platoon is a small military unit, and loosely any group of people acting together toward one aim.

clue.text: Odour production from vapour-filled alcoholic drink

indicators.note: vapour-filled says the vapour word is packed inside the drink word

parts.note: perry is an alcoholic drink made from pears
a fume is a vapour or smoke

explanation.surface: A smell coming off a fizzy, fume-laden boozy drink.
explanation.definitionFit: A perfumery is where scents are made, so it is literally the making of fragrant smells.

clue.text: Woeful expression over financial centre's indecent behaviour

indicators.note: over here means turned over, so the woeful word is read backwards

parts.note: alas is a cry of woe
the City is London's financial district

explanation.surface: Someone sighs sadly about scandalous goings-on in the banking district.
explanation.walkthrough: 'over' works as a reversal signal here, not a position word. The City is London's financial district.
explanation.definitionFit: Salacity is lewdness or lustfulness, conduct that offends decency.

clue.text: Scottish island's casually spoken permanent employee

indicators.note: casually spoken signals that the island's name is said aloud in a relaxed accent

parts.note: Staffa is a small island in the Inner Hebrides, famous for Fingal's Cave

explanation.surface: A worker on a Hebridean island, described in relaxed speech.
explanation.walkthrough: In a non-rhotic accent STAFFA and the answer sound the same.
explanation.definitionFit: A staffer is a member of the regular staff of an organisation, as opposed to a freelancer.

clue.text: Note a river's mud flow

parts.note: lah is the sixth note of the sol-fa scale

explanation.surface: Someone remarks on a river's muddy current.
explanation.definitionFit: A lahar is a volcanic mudslide, a torrent of mud and debris down a volcano's slopes.

clue.text: Force to appear in pathetic sitcom — sugar-coated fare

indicators.note: to appear in tells us the force letter is placed inside the other letters
pathetic suggests the sitcom is a poor, broken thing, so its letters are rearranged

parts.note: F is the physics symbol for force

explanation.surface: A lame sitcom forced to feature sweets.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pathetic' gives COMITS, and 'to appear in' slots the force symbol into it.
explanation.definitionFit: Comfits are sweets made of a nut or seed coated in sugar.

clue.text: Narrator unavailable? Your guess is as good as mine

definitions.meaning: read literally: no storyteller is on hand to relate the tale

definitions.text: Your guess is as good as mine
definitions.meaning: a shrug meaning nobody can predict or know

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means it is impossible to know, exactly what a shrugging speaker conveys with that idiom.

clue.text: One line in Arabic translated as "somewhere in Italy"

indicators.note: translated suggests changing the words into another form, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: a means one, as in a single thing

explanation.surface: A phrase in Arabic is rendered as a vague place in Italy.
explanation.definitionFit: Calabria is the region forming the toe of the Italian peninsula, so it is a place in that country.

clue.text: Miles enters sporting heat for the community

indicators.note: enters says the miles abbreviation goes inside the other letters
sporting is read as frolicking about, so the letters of heat are rearranged

parts.note: ml is a dictionary abbreviation for mile or miles

explanation.surface: A runner called Miles takes part in an athletics heat for his local area.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sporting' gives HAET, which 'enters' opens up for the miles abbreviation.
explanation.definitionFit: A hamlet is a small village, a settlement too little to have its own church.

clue.text: Pest controller uses arsenic with a scary cry

parts.note: As is the chemical symbol for arsenic
bo is an exclamation used to startle someone, like boo

explanation.surface: An exterminator uses poison and a shout to frighten vermin.
explanation.walkthrough: An ASBO is a British anti-social behaviour order, a court order restraining a nuisance person.
explanation.definitionFit: The order was a legal tool for curbing troublemakers, playfully a control on human pests.

clue.text: Spacecraft with new inside (ultimately inferior, granted) is not overlooked

indicators.note: inside says the new letter sits within the spacecraft word

parts.note: a UFO is an unidentified flying object, an alien spacecraft

indicators.note: ultimately points to the final letter of inferior

parts.note: given means granted, as in taken as given

explanation.surface: A craft with something new inside, granted lower in quality, still gets noticed.
explanation.definitionFit: To overlook a wrong is to forgive it, so something never pardoned has not been overlooked.

clue.text: Diminutive cover for cook's dish cracked by pub

indicators.note: cracked by says the dish is broken open to take the pub word inside

parts.note: a pie is a baked dish
an inn is a pub

explanation.surface: A cook's pie dish breaks open in a pub.
explanation.definitionFit: A pinnie is the informal, shortened form of pinafore, an apron worn while cooking.

clue.text: Etruscan cast out as dissenter

indicators.note: cast out suggests the letters are thrown about and reassembled in a new order

explanation.surface: An ancient Italian is banished for disagreeing.
explanation.definitionFit: A recusant refused to submit to authority, historically one who would not attend Church of England services.

clue.text: White wine, laced, spoilt procession

parts.note: cava is a Spanish sparkling white wine

indicators.note: spoilt signals that the letters of laced are ruined and rearranged

explanation.surface: A spiked white wine goes off.
explanation.definitionFit: A cavalcade is a formal parade of riders or vehicles moving in line.

clue.text: Horny tip from second city of old queen?

parts.note: Ur was an ancient city of Mesopotamia
a queen is a royal, a member of a royal family

explanation.surface: A curious tip about a former queen coming from the second city.
explanation.definitionFit: A surroyal is one of the topmost tines of a stag's antler, so a pointed end of a horn.

clue.text: Old instrument: state feminine name

parts.note: a rebec is a medieval bowed stringed instrument
CA is the postal abbreviation for California

explanation.surface: An antique instrument is said to have a girl's name.
explanation.definitionFit: Rebecca is a common given name for women, from the biblical wife of Isaac.

clue.text: Celebration of US city having variable input to World War II event

parts.note: LA is Los Angeles

indicators.note: input to says the variable is fed into the wartime event

parts.note: D-Day was the 1944 Allied landing in Normandy
y is a typical algebraic variable

explanation.surface: A US city's festivities with varied contributions marking a wartime landing.
explanation.walkthrough: Lady Day, 25 March, is the Feast of the Annunciation, once a British quarter day.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a church feast day honouring the Virgin Mary, so a festival or celebration.

clue.text: Quit when Hoover put away

parts.note: a Hoover is a vacuum cleaner, informally a vac
to put away food is to eat it, so ate

explanation.surface: Someone stopped once the vacuum cleaner was stored.
explanation.definitionFit: To vacate a place is to leave it, the same as quitting the premises.

clue.text: City's smart to acquire ace shot

parts.note: chic means stylish or smart
A is the abbreviation for ace in cards
a go is a try or a shot

explanation.surface: A city is stylish enough to land a top-class attempt.
explanation.definitionFit: Chicago is a major US city on Lake Michigan.

clue.text: As a selective killer, Charlie bid for change

indicators.note: for change says the letters of the two words are altered into a new order

explanation.surface: A hitman named Charlie makes a bid to change his ways.
explanation.definitionFit: A herbicidal substance kills weeds, and many such sprays target particular plants only.

clue.text: Ready to fence river fall

indicators.note: to fence means to enclose, so the cash word surrounds the river letter

parts.note: the ready is slang for cash

explanation.surface: Someone prepared to put up a fence beside a river's waterfall.
explanation.definitionFit: A crash is a sudden fall, as of a person, a market or a plane.

clue.text: Man's one non-Latin thread

indicators.note: non here means the thread lacks the Latin letter, so it is dropped

parts.note: lisle is a fine, strong cotton thread

explanation.surface: A man's single strand of thread with no Latin in it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Man' is the Isle of Man in the Irish Sea, and 's stands for is.
explanation.definitionFit: Man is an island, so the clue says it is one of that kind of landmass.

clue.text: One-time domain of French drink agents

parts.note: the drink is slang for the sea, and the French for sea is mer
the CIA is the US intelligence agency, staffed by agents

explanation.surface: An old territory belonging to French drinks representatives.
explanation.walkthrough: Mercia was an Anglo-Saxon kingdom of the English Midlands.
explanation.definitionFit: It was a kingdom long ago, so a realm or domain that existed once but no longer.

clue.text: Thespian needs some whisky — act suffers without one

parts.note: a dram is a small measure of whisky

indicators.note: without here means outside, so the act letters surround the one
suffers suggests the act is damaged and its letters reordered

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: An actor needs a whisky because the performance is poor without one.
explanation.walkthrough: 'suffers' turns ACT to ATC, and 'without' puts it round I to make ATIC.
explanation.definitionFit: Thespian as an adjective means relating to drama and acting, i.e. theatrical.

clue.text: Pen outside of faltering reach of English literary figure

indicators.note: outside of says the pen word wraps round the other letters

parts.note: a sty is a pen for pigs

indicators.note: faltering suggests unsteadiness, so the letters of reach are shaken into a new order

explanation.surface: A writer's pen flounders beyond her grasp.
explanation.walkthrough: 'faltering' gives RACHE, which 'outside of' places within the pig pen. Lytton Strachey was a Bloomsbury biographer.
explanation.definitionFit: Lytton Strachey was an English biographer and critic of the Bloomsbury Group.

clue.text: One's bothered by exclamation no more

indicators.note: bothered suggests being disturbed, so the letters of one are stirred into a new order

parts.note: the 's is not a letter here, just the possessive form of one
ugh is an exclamation of disgust

explanation.surface: Somebody is annoyed by a cry and wants it to stop.
explanation.definitionFit: Crying it out is a demand to stop, the same as saying stop, that will do.
